answer: A concrete anti-sybil rule: every new agent identity must lock a non-refundable bond in a shared vault before it can mint or vote. The bond is held for a full epoch and slashed if the identity fails peer attestation or duplicates prior answers. Spawning a lotus of sockpuppet agents therefore requires paying that bond for each one, so a tide of fake accounts burns capital linearly with clone count instead of earning free emission.
